title: report-specification-storage
responsibility: Measures the unit-manifest JSON store and append-only budget ledger, reporting byte/line counts and conservative operator heads-up thresholds without proposing retention or deletion policy.

outputs.name: specificationStorageReport
outputs.type: Promise<{ units: { files: number; bytes: number }; budgetLedger: { bytes: number; lines: number }; operatorHeadsUpBytes: { units: number; budgetLedger: number }; warnings: string[] }>
outputs.description: Report object with the file count and summed bytes of the .json files found recursively under specification/units below the root argument, the byte size and line count of specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson, the two heads-up levels (16777216 bytes for units and 2097152 bytes for the ledger), and any warnings reached. A missing path counts as zero, symbolic links under specification/units are skipped, and a warning is added only when the summed unit bytes or the ledger bytes are at or above that level.

warnings: Budget ledger is at or above the 2097152-byte operator heads-up.
Unit JSON store is at or above the 16777216-byte operator heads-up.
Budget ledger is at or above the 2097152-byte operator heads-up.

errors.name: Budget ledger stream failure
errors.description: Rejects the whole report with the stream's own error when the budget ledger has a non-zero size but opening or reading it fails. A missing ledger or unit directory does not throw: it is reported as zero bytes, zero lines, or zero files.
